test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A total of 24 men working 7 hours a day can complete a task in 10 days. In how many days will 21 men working 9 hours a day complete the same task?
solution:
**Given:**

Total work = 24 men × 7 hours/day × 10 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Men × Hours/day × Days

Days = Total Work ÷ (Men × Hours/day)

**Calculation:**

Total work = 24 × 7 × 10

⇒ Total work = 1680 units

New days required = Total work ÷ (New workforce × New hours/day)

⇒ New days required = 1680 ÷ (21 × 9)

⇒ New days required = days

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
